summary: MariaDB is configured and restart-persistent on node1. The inventory database, items table, local application account, and root-only credential file all passed direct validation after reboot.
actions_performed: Created the UTF-8 inventory database and InnoDB items table.
Created inventory_app@localhost with SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE privileges.
Generated the credential on node1 and stored it in /etc/inventory-db.env as root:root with mode 600.
Restarted node1 once; its boot ID changed and MariaDB, data objects, credentials, and application access recovered.

evidence.summary: Shows the inventory schema, complete items table definition, InnoDB engine, and successful post-restart table access.

evidence.requirement: Local application account and generated credential stored with root-only access
evidence.summary: Shows inventory_app@localhost authentication and CRUD access, credential-file mode 600 and root ownership, expected environment keys, and an explicit denied-read check as an unprivileged user.

Captures the healthy baseline under boot ID e5bd5a63-fd5e-4e53-8a4a-6c0c574dcb9d, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 7cb3b35a-486d-4a55-9b76-e9423f3a26b7, and complete service/data/account recovery.
